ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import buildAssessmentResult from dwl::assessment output application/java var childText = "<project><parent><relativePath>../../pom.xml</relativePath></parent></project>" var childPom = read(childText, "application/xml") var parentPom = read("<project><properties><app.runtime>4.6.0</app.runtime></properties></project>", "application/xml") var chain = [{ path: "modules/app/pom.xml", pom: childPom }, { path: "pom.xml", pom: parentPom }] var matrix = { target: { runtime: "4.9.18", javaVersion: "17" }, muleArtifact: { minMuleVersion: "4.9.0", javaSpecificationVersions: ["17"] }, gating: { r: { property: "app.runtime", set: "4.9.18" } }, connectors: [] } --- buildAssessmentResult(matrix, chain, childText, null, null, null, null, "myapp", "PARENT_APP", "sha123", false, false, false, [], "inPlace")

munit:test.name: assessment-computePropEditsOverride-connectors
munit:test.description: appOverride pins a declared connector (ref→property, literal→replace) and SKIPS version-less + undeclared connectors

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import computePropEditsOverride from dwl::assessment output application/java var appText = "<project>" ++ "<properties/>" ++ "<dependencies>" ++ "<dependency><groupId>org.mule.connectors</groupId><artifactId>mule-http-connector</artifactId><version>\u0024{http.connector.version}</version></dependency>" ++ "<dependency><groupId>org.mule.modules</groupId><artifactId>mule-apikit-module</artifactId><version>1.6.0</version></dependency>" ++ "<dependency><groupId>org.mule.connectors</groupId><artifactId>mule-sockets-connector</artifactId></dependency>" ++ "</dependencies>" ++ "</project>" var appPom = read(appText, "application/xml") var chain = [{ path: "app/pom.xml", pom: appPom }] var matrix = { gating: {}, connectors: [ { property: "http.connector.version", set: "1.11.3", groupId: "org.mule.connectors", artifactId: "mule-http-connector" }, { property: "apikit.version", set: "1.11.8", groupId: "org.mule.modules", artifactId: "mule-apikit-module" }, { property: "sockets.version", set: "1.2.4", groupId: "org.mule.connectors", artifactId: "mule-sockets-connector" }, { property: "db.version", set: "1.14.0", groupId: "org.mule.connectors", artifactId: "mule-db-connector" } ] } --- computePropEditsOverride(chain, matrix)

munit:test.name: pomChain-normalizePath-and-initChain
munit:test.description: normalizePath collapses .. segments; initChain decodes base64, parses the pom and resolves the next parent path in-tree

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import normalizePath, initChain from dwl::pomChain import toBase64 from dw::core::Binaries output application/java var appXml = "<project><parent><relativePath>../pom.xml</relativePath></parent></project>" var b64 = toBase64(appXml as Binary) var chainInit = initChain(b64, "modules/app/pom.xml", ["modules/app/pom.xml", "modules/pom.xml", "pom.xml"]) --- { norm1: normalizePath("a/b/pom.xml", "../pom.xml"), norm2: normalizePath("a/b/c/pom.xml", "../../pom.xml"), nextParent: chainInit.nextParentPath, firstPath: chainInit.chain[0].path, hasText: (chainInit.appPomText contains "<project>") }

munit:test.name: assessment-buildAssessmentResult-rehydrates-from-pomText
munit:test.description: buildAssessmentResult re-reads pomText so connector pins survive a collapsed parsed .pom

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import buildAssessmentResult from dwl::assessment output application/java var appText = "<project xmlns='http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0'>" ++ "<properties/>" ++ "<build><plugins><plugin><groupId>com.mulesoft.munit.tools</groupId><artifactId>munit-maven-plugin</artifactId><version>\u0024{munit.version}</version></plugin></plugins></build>" ++ "<dependencies>" ++ "<dependency><groupId>com.mulesoft.munit</groupId><artifactId>munit-runner</artifactId><classifier>mule-plugin</classifier><scope>test</scope></dependency>" ++ "<dependency><groupId>org.mule.connectors</groupId><artifactId>mule-http-connector</artifactId><version>1.6.0</version><classifier>mule-plugin</classifier></dependency>" ++ "<dependency><groupId>org.mule.connectors</groupId><artifactId>mule-vm-connector</artifactId><classifier>mule-plugin</classifier></dependency>" ++ "</dependencies>" ++ "</project>" // Deliberately collapsed parsed pom: it has NO dependencies (simulates java.util.Map key loss). var collapsedPom = read("<project xmlns='http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0'><properties/></project>", "application/xml") var chain = [{ path: "pom.xml", pom: collapsedPom, pomText: appText }] var matrix = { target: { runtime: "4.9.18", javaVersion: "17" }, gating: { munit: { property: "munit.version", min: "3.6.3", set: "3.6.3", groupId: "com.mulesoft.munit", artifactId: "munit-runner", pluginGroupId: "com.mulesoft.munit.tools", pluginArtifactId: "munit-maven-plugin" } }, connectors: [ { property: "http.connector.version", set: "1.11.3", groupId: "org.mule.connectors", artifactId: "mule-http-connector" } ], muleArtifact: { minMuleVersion: "4.9.0", javaSpecificationVersions: ["17"] } } --- buildAssessmentResult(matrix, chain, appText, null, "mule-artifact.json", null, null, "collapse-app", "APP_STANDALONE", "sha", false, false, false, [], "appOverride", ["munit-runner","munit-tools"])

munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: http connector pinned (from pomText, not collapsed .pom)
munit-tools:assert-that.expression: #[sizeOf((vars.result.changePlan.fileEdits default []) filter ((e) -> (e.kind default '') == 'depVersion' and (e.artifactId default '') == 'mule-http-connector' and e.to == '1.11.3'))]

munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: uncovered mule connector surfaced as missing-from-matrix
